subject: chemistry
content: A solution of a nonvolatile solute in water freezes at -0.30<sup>o</sup>C. The vapour pressure of pure water at 298 K s 23.51 mm Hg and K<sub>f</sub> for water is 1.86 K kg mol<sup>-1</sup>. Calculate the vapour pressure of this solution at 298 K.
